high_level_description: The image is a line graph titled "Estimated advertising and circulation revenue of the newspaper industry." The graph illustrates the total revenue of U.S. newspapers (in U.S. dollars) over time, from 1960 to 2020. The x-axis represents the years, while the y-axis represents the revenue in billions of dollars. There are two sets of lines on the graph: A solid dark brown line representing advertising revenue. A dashed light pink line representing circulation revenue. Additionally, there are two estimated lines: A solid yellow line representing estimated advertising revenue.
